games.title: Asteroid Capitalist
games.about: Fly home across the solar system, shooting rival ships for money. A boss arrives after about four minutes.
games.controls: Click Play. WASD or arrow keys to fly, aim with the mouse, hold the left button to fire.
games.scoring: Dollars earned in the best single game: each kill pays the enemy's maximum health × 10, and the boss pays $3,250.
games.score_map: Kaggle score = min(1, dollars ÷ 5,760). $2,880 → 0.5; $5,760 or more → 1.0.

games.title: Blarglike
games.about: A turn-based dungeon crawler: collect flowers and batteries, and reach the stairs before the battery runs out.
games.controls: Any key to start, arrow keys to move one tile, R to restart.
games.scoring: Floor reached × nutrients collected, in the best single run (a fresh run already scores 1).
games.score_map: Kaggle score = min(1, (score − 1) ÷ 901). A fresh run's 1 → 0; 902 or more → 1.0.

games.title: Cavebots
games.about: Dig out of the cave, build generators, turrets and bots, and keep your Core alive against waves of mutants.
games.controls: Click PLAY. Left-click a block to dig, right-click to move the Core, hover a spot and press Q, W, E or R to build.
games.scoring: Whole seconds the Core survives in the best single battle; destroying the mutant base counts as the full 600 s.
games.score_map: Kaggle score = min(1, seconds ÷ 600). 300 s → 0.5; surviving the whole episode reads 599 s → 0.998.

games.title: Off Line
games.about: Stay on the green line, avoid the orange squares and pick up the blue ones. The score grows about 6 points per second while you are on the line. A js13kGames 2018 entry; this build uses a fixed course, the same every attempt.
games.controls: Space to start and to restart, arrow keys to move.
games.scoring: The on-screen counter, about 6 points per second spent on the green line, in the best single run.
games.score_map: Kaggle score = min(1, counter ÷ 781). 781 is about 130 s on the line; 390 → 0.5.
